about_the_game:
「We offer hymns of praise to the gods, and they respond with mournful songs」

The hundred years of the human demon war may only be a fleeting moment in the eyes of the gods.

Over the past hundred years, countless humans and demon heroes have been born on the continent of Troy, and their destinies are closely linked to this great war. Like countless beings, there are also countless spirits among them who have fallen in this war.

In this period of history, the most brilliant and dazzling person among humanity is undoubtedly Kongji, who single handedly interrupted the war between humans and demons for several years. He is also the creator, sacrificial, and sacrificial of the legendary oath - the Soul Universe.

Legend has it that the Soul Universe can create a soul wormhole in the spiritual world of the vow maker Summon powerful souls from another world through this.

And your soul, as one of the powerful souls in another world, seems to have already written your name in the history of the continent of Troy.

In the rolling river of history, the sea has changed, the hero has passed away, and the war between humans and demons has once again erupted. In the following time, Yunxi, the daughter of Kongji, will face a fierce and extraordinary fate.

What kind of people will you meet and embark on a soul journey with her when you are called to go?

But please remember, the most important thing in the game is always your choice! The various choices and experiences in the game world will ultimately reflect your soul.
